'''R5-PHT''' was a [[Color|black]] and silver plated [[R5 series astromech droid]] that served the [[Galactic Empire]]. It was equipped with a [[Kerner Optical]] [[Holoprojector|holographic projector]] and had black [[sensor]]s.<ref name="SoloOG" /> Like all [[R-series|R5]] [[astromech droid]]s, it was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]] and stood ninety-seven [[centimeter]]s tall.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />

In [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events on [[Corellia]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', which includes R5-PHT's appearance, to [[13 BBY]].</ref> the [[droid]] was stationed in [[Coronet City Spaceport|Coronet Spaceport]] in [[Coronet City]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]]. It stood by an [[Imperial officer]] in front of an elevated duty station while the [[scrumrat]]s [[Han Solo]] and [[Qi'ra]] tried to sneak through the [[spaceport]]'s Imperial customs gates. It remained stationary when a group of [[stormtrooper]]s and members of the [[White Worms]] gang rushed past it with two [[Corellian hound]]s in pursuit of the fugitives.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
R5-PHT was created for the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology film]], ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo" /> The droid was first revealed prior to the film's release as part of a [[Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|''Star Wars: Droid Factory'']] toy set produced by [[Hasbro]] earlier in 2018.<ref name="RS-news">{{Rebelscum|url=story/front/New_Disney_Parks_Droid_Factory_Astromech_Set_Is_Out_180403.asp|text=New Disney Parks Droid Factory Astromech Set Is Out|author=David Martin|date=2018-04-04}}</ref>
